test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Eclispe**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**Eclispe**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Eclipse**'.
 
• It means** 'an occasion when the moon or the sun seems to completely or partly disappear because one of them is passing between the other and the earth** (चंद्रमा या सूर्य का कुछ देर के लिए, पूर्ण रूप से, या आंशिक रूप से पृथ्‍वी वासियों को दिखाई न पड़ना; ग्रहण)'.
 
 
• *Example: a total/partial **eclipse** of the sun...*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Economic**: connected with the supply of money, business, industry, etc. (आर्थिक; धन के लेन-देन, व्‍यापार, उद्योग आदि से संबंधित) 
 
• **Echo**: a sound that is repeated as it is sent back off a surface such as the wall of a tunnel. (गूँज, प्रतिध्वनि)
 
• **Ecology**: the relationship between living things and their surroundings; the study of this subject. (सजीवों का अपने परिवेश से संबंध; पर्यावरण का अध्ययन; पर्यावरण-विज्ञान)
